channel.description: Living document. This page will change as development continues. Last updated: September 27, 2026. Working title. The codebase and the hosted platform may end up with different names. What it is The Kansas Historical Data Project has three parts: An open-source platform for collecting, curating, and publishing crowdsourced historical data. A digital archive of oral histories, scanned documents, and photographs. Contributors can upload these materials, and anyone can search and retrieve them. An interactive data visualization tool for exploring the data through maps, timelines, and charts. Everything on the platform, including data and archive items, can be searched and organized by place and time.
